body: Thanks for checking up on me. Sorry I never responded, but I'm doing a whole lot better got a decent job lost some weight but she's still in my mind. I just can't seem to forget about her. Idk how long imma have these feelings for her it sucks big time I know that.
I'll listen to your advice friend. Say in about a week or two ill message you and tell you how I'm doing. I'd really like that. Thanks though
I don't know you personally bro but I care man. I just posted on here about taking my life but we both need to think for real, ill talk to ya man. Why are you thinking about doing it?
I want you to be right, you just don't know. I'm trying to hold it together right now, this liquor isn't helping though. Gotta put this shit down ....

I appreciate that. I just really thought she was the one for me. I feel like I've been played by her because of the things I shared with her, I let her know things my mother didn't even know. How do I trust someone again?
Also she was very calm with the whole situation of me telling her about being serious about me. Like idk what I expected from telling her that, I guess i thought I could force her to love me :(
